sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể sửa túi ở đâu? is useful when the map, sign, or building layout is not giving you the final answer. It names repair my bag in a compact way, so a local can point, give a landmark, or send you to the right counter.

sections.body: Keep it short: Tôi có thể sửa túi ở đâu?. Show your item, receipt, photo, address, or phone screen, then listen for the first useful clue: a point, floor, street, counter, or landmark.
